orgs.name: CURE SYNGAP1 (formerly SRF)
orgs.snippet: SYNGAP1-Related Disorders (SRD) are ultra-rare genetic disorders caused by a variant on the SYNGAP1 gene.

orgs.name: SYNGAP1 (MRD5) Patient Registry
orgs.snippet: The SYNGAP1 (MRD5) Registry follows strict government guidelines to assure patient information is protected.

orgs.name: Simons Searchlight – SYNGAP1
orgs.snippet: SYNGAP1-related syndrome is also called SYNGAP1-related intellectual disability (SYNGAP1-ID) or intellectual developmental disorder, autosomal dominant 5.

orgs.name: Syngap Global Network (SGN)
orgs.snippet: We have come together to drive the global unification of Syngap1-related efforts and initiatives.

orgs.name: SYNGAP1 UK
orgs.snippet: SYNGAP1 UK is a national organisation supporting individuals and families affected by SYNGAP1-related intellectual disability.
